rules.name: tool argument schema
rules.reverseCase: subtitle+sceneId 必须通过，global+sceneId 必须拒绝

rules.name: dispatcher scene target resolution
rules.reverseCase: 未知 sceneId 返回友好 gate=dispatcher_target；scene/visual_strategy 无 sceneId 时回退选中镜头

rules.name: revision scope filter
rules.reverseCase: 越界字段（其他镜头/字幕/转场/音频）必须从候选丢弃

rules.name: revision commit gate
rules.reverseCase: 零差异候选必须拒绝，真实范围差异必须通过

rules.name: transition multi-target scope
rules.reverseCase: 多个真实转场可在同一 revision 中修改，空目标、过期目标和非目标转场变化必须拒绝或隔离

rules.name: tool receipt reply truth
rules.reverseCase: Tool 失败或部分成功时不得保留模型执行前的完成声明

rules.name: semantic outcome review
rules.reverseCase: 模型改写措辞但语义正确时不得判无关

rules.name: delivery authorization
rules.reverseCase: 交付只依赖本轮 execute 意图，不要求原文重复授权

rules.name: system field binding
rules.reverseCase: 模型参数不得覆盖 userId/draftId/revision 等系统字段

rules.name: required-fact assertions
rules.reverseCase: “克制一点的科幻感”必须匹配“克制科幻”

rules.name: reply quality judge
rules.reverseCase: 讨论草稿版本的问题不得判 off_topic

rules.name: generation input public URL normalization
rules.reverseCase: 本地上传图片在规划前自动发布为可达 URL；已公网 URL 原样透传
